# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **GPU rendering correctness**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 receives upstream fixes for GPU path bounds, clipping, and recorded glyph replay. These updates retain Skia milestone 156 and leave managed APIs unchanged.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **GPU paths and clipping corrected** — Corrects Ganesh device-space path bounds and software coverage-mask subset clamping, plus Graphite clip-key packing and wedge miter bounds. ([#5617](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5617))
- **Recorded glyph replay validated** — Validates serialized Slug positions, matrices, bounds, and flags; bounds direct-mask offsets and preserves creation-time rounding. Ganesh and Graphite retain rendering fallbacks when glyph data cannot safely use atlas bilinear sampling. ([#5617](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5617), [#5624](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5624))
